description: Faithfulness / grounding set. Measures whether each answer's claims are supported by the excerpts the model was actually given (the anti-hallucination check on the GENERATION step). Reference-free: we don't compare to a gold answer, we check groundedness against retrieved context. Unanswerable cases must refuse (0 claims, 0 fabricated citations).
